result.reason: The test suite conforms to the Test Conventions specification. The top-level describe names the unit by module name ('apply-discount'); every nested describe uses a 'when' clause; each it states one observable outcome so describe + it reads as a sentence. Every it block contains exactly one expect, and compound shapes are asserted once with toMatchObject/toEqual. Tests exercise only the public run API and observable returned values, use the honest in-memory store rather than mocks/spies, and build fresh data inside each test with no cross-suite state dependence.

The test file fully complies with all requirements in the specification: 1) Subject framing follows the pattern with module name, 'when' clauses, and readable outcome sentences; 2) Each 'it' block contains exactly one assertion using appropriate matchers; 3) Tests exercise only public API without spies/mocking, use fresh test data, and assert on observable functionality.
